subject: english
title: Grammar 2
subtitle: Weather rules — the zero conditional (If + present, present), SB p. 15, TR 1.7.

content: Say what he always does when the weather changes.
Solve problems: a problem → what I do.
language: Use the zero conditional: If + present, present (If it rains, I use an umbrella.).
Keep both verbs present, with -s for he / she / it, and use the comma when if comes first.
Use academic language: logical, condition, depend.
